title: phegopteris incisa
intro: Phegopteris incisa, commonly known as the cut-leaf fern or Japanese chain fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris incisa include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Phegopteris incisa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
